description: Return Flare's monetary metrics: circulating and committed supply, total staked, staking ratio, WFLR supply, annualized inflation (rate + FLR/yr), and the FLR burn rate (daily + annualized estimate) with net supply change. Source is on-chain reads plus a live block sample for the burn estimate. Nulls (not zeros) returned for any leg whose on-chain read fails.
name: get_network_economics
title: Get Network Economics
